fields.problem: The claim 'accepts sequences up to 512 nt' inferred a limit from pre-training data filtering rather than model max_length=514.
fields.before: Structure-guided RNA foundation model pre-trained with Structure-guided Masked Language Modeling (SgMLM) on about 21 million RNA sequence-structure pairs, producing classification-level, sequence-level and pairwise matrix features. It has 768 hidden dimensions, 12 layers and 12 attention heads and accepts sequences up to 512 nt.
